gloss: to pay attention to; to focus on; to watch closely

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to focus on; to take notice of; to watch closely
definitions.explanation: To direct one's attention or interest toward something or someone, often because it is important, noteworthy, or promising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{注目|ちゅうもく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注目|ちゅうもく}してほしい。
examples.english: I want you to pay attention to this issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{注目|ちゅうもく}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is attracting attention as a young athlete.

notes:
{注目|ちゅうもく}する means to direct one's gaze or attention toward something noteworthy. It combines ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (pour) and {目|もく} (eye), literally "pouring one's eyes" on something. The passive form {注目|ちゅうもく}される (to be noticed; to attract attention) is extremely common.

USAGE:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注目|ちゅうもく}する: pay attention to ~
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{注目|ちゅうもく}される: ~ attracts attention (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to attract attention
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}を{浴|あ}びる→注目を浴びる：20630_chuumokuwoabiru⟧: to be in the spotlight
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}{度|ど}→注目度：21918_chuumokudo⟧: degree of attention; popularity
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧: stock to watch
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧すべき⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: point worth noting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧: to be careful; to watch out — focuses on caution rather than interest
- ⟦{着目|ちゃくもく}→着目：13661_chakumoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to focus on — more analytical, used when singling out a specific aspect for examination
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: to stand out — describes the object being conspicuous, not the observer's action
